title: Re-order a towing authorisation book
summary: Learn how to re-order a towing authorisation book for an accident towing tow truck.
intro:
If you operate an accident towing tow truck it must have a towing authorisation book.

To re-order a towing authorisation book, you'll need to visit a service centre.
who_can_apply: Operate an accident towing tow truck
what_you_need: A completed re-order form (found at the back of your current book)
A current certificate of registration for the tow truck
The schedule issued under the tow truck operator licence
EFTPOS, credit, or debit card (cash may not be accepted at all locations)

faqs.q: What is a towing authorisation book?
faqs.a: If you operate an accident towing tow truck, you must have a towing authorisation book.

faqs.q: How do I re-order a towing authorisation book?
faqs.a: You must visit a service centre to re-order a towing authorisation book.

faqs.q: What payment methods are accepted at service centres?
faqs.a: Service centres accept EFTPOS, credit, or debit card, but not all locations accept cash.
